primary_source.title: Multi-Atlas Segmentation with Joint Label Fusion
primary_source.support: Models spatial pairwise atlas-error dependencies rather than assigning independent atlas weights; local intensity similarity estimates the dependency matrix.
primary_source.access_scope: Primary abstract and indexed primary text verified; direct PMC full-text page presented browser challenge, publisher implementation page timed out. No claim to reproduce full original protocol.

adaptation: RACE8 uses other-seven majority disagreement as an unlabelled error proxy, estimates patchwise second moments, and regularizes the inverse matrix. Nonnegative renormalization and clipped uncertain-region residual updates are engineering choices, not original JLF guarantees.
risk: Same-network view errors can be correlated and shared errors can evade consensus. Error-proxy agreement is not observed error probability. Validation Dice and matched diagonal controls determine this experiment's outcome.
